name: order-management

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run test:e2e
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build

description: A small React + TypeScript frontend and Express + TypeScript API for one-warehouse stock and customer orders. SQLite persists inventory and orders.
